answer_1.quote: Automatic approaches for retrieving and assigning images from the web to textbook chapters can therefore assist textbook designers in the creation of better textbooks.

answer_2.quote: We use CLIP's similarity scores for image-phrase relevance (detailed in Section 4).

answer_4.quote: We selected 32 crowd-workers from Prolific who are native English speakers and work in education.
answer_4.guideline: The annotators first answer the local questions for all images and then the global questions. This way we made sure that they scanned the entire section and had a some overview of all images and how they relate to each other before answering the global questions.
